subject: Draft MAP: POC infra readiness & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@novaforge.io>, ops+infra@gridlytics.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: POC infra readiness & acceptance criteria

Hi Alice & Gridlytics infra team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC infra milestone so we can align on owners, dependencies, and clear acceptance criteria. High-level items in this version:

- Target close for POC readiness: 2027-05-13 (we should confirm if this lines up with your internal approval windows)
- Required infra tasks: VPC peering, static egress IPs/IP allowlist, SSO via SAML, KMS/secrets access for model keys, and a basic network smoke test (see checklist).
- Owners: Novaforge to own peering and identity sync, Gridlytics to validate IP egress map (if different), Redwood to provide jumpbox image and test harness.

Please review the acceptance criteria column in the spreadsheet and flag any items that are blockers. My ask for this week: can we confirm the SSO contact and the person who will request KMS access? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up to run the checklist together.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP table + milestones), network-smoke-test-checklist.pdf (proposed tests).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm SSO & KMS owners by EOD Wed (2027-04-23).
2) Gridlytics posts egress IP ranges to the MAP and adds any cloud peering windows.
3) Redwood schedules a short smoke-test window once peering is in place.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear doc. We reviewed with infra and security; a few quick notes:

- We can commit to the 2027-05-13 readiness target but will need a 48-hour window after peering to validate production-like traffic.
- SSO contact: Alice Nguyen (me) will own the SAML setup end-to-end and will loop in our identity team (identity+ssosupport@novaforge.io) for metadata exchange.
- KMS/secrets: we'll need Redwood's guidance on KMS key policies. Our security team prefers customer-managed CMEK for the POC — is that supported?
- Egress IPs: ops+infra@gridlytics.com will confirm the public IP list by tomorrow.

I'll upload our internal contact and a short network diagram to the Drive link you shared. Quick question: for the smoke test you propose, do you want us to run the client-side tests or should Redwood run them from the jumpbox?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Director of Platform, Novaforge Analytics
alice.nguyen@novaforge.io

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@novaforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ops+infra@gridlytics.com
Date: 2027-04-23T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: POC infra readiness & acceptance criteria

Adding a few operational clarifications and acceptance criteria so the MAP can be actionable for our delivery team:

- VPC peering: acceptance = successful TCP handshake on port 443 from Redwood jumpbox to Novaforge model endpoint + traceroute showing private connectivity. Owner: Novaforge networking (contact: identity+ssosupport@novaforge.io).
- IP Allowlist / Egress: acceptance = Redwood test harness can POST 100 small inference requests within a 5-minute window with <200ms p95 response. Owner: Gridlytics ops (ops+infra). Please provide exact egress ranges and NAT gateway IPs.
- SSO / SAML: acceptance = user provisioning via SAML works for one test user and SSO login to the Redwood Console. Owner: Alice (Novaforge). We'll provide SAML metadata and a short checklist.
- KMS / Secrets: acceptance = Redwood can retrieve a test encrypted model key via your KMS policy and decrypt locally in the POC environment. If CMEK is required, we need the key ARN and a cross-account access policy. Owner: Novaforge security.
- Secret injection: for security, we prefer using HashiCorp Vault or cloud KMS-backed secret provider. If you have a different secret manager, include the API docs link in the MAP.

Attachments: I updated MAP_draft_v1.xlsx with the acceptance criteria column filled out and added a separate worksheet called "test-windows". Also attached a short network-smoke-test-checklist.pdf with the initial tests and expected outputs.

For the smoke test run: propose the following split — Novaforge validates routing (can you run the client-side traceroutes) and Redwood will run the end-to-end inference burst from the jumpbox to validate throughput and auth. This minimizes coordination friction.

I'll hold a 30-min technical sync on Friday 2027-04-25 @ 10:00 PDT — let me know if that works and I'll send the calendar invite.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ops+infra@gridlytics.com
Date: 2027-04-23T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: POC infra readiness & acceptance criteria

Appreciate the quick replies and ownership, team. Action items recap and owners below — please treat this as the MAP milestone checklist to close by 2027-05-13: 

1) Novaforge (Alice / identity+ssosupport): share SAML metadata, confirm CMEK ARN if required — due 2027-04-24 EOD.
2) Gridlytics (ops+infra): publish egress IP list and any peering maintenance windows — due 2027-04-23 EOD.
3) Redwood (Karthik): provide SAML metadata, jumpbox AMI, and a short runbook for the smoke test — due 2027-04-24 midday.
4) All: confirm 30-min sync on 2027-04-25 10:00 PDT or propose alternate.

Acceptance criteria (summary): private connectivity verified, SSO login succeeds, KMS decrypt test passes, and a short burst of inference with p95 < 200ms. Once those are green we mark the POC infra milestone complete and schedule an extended load window.

If anyone has regulatory or audit checklist items (e.g., explicit logging/audit capture required for KMS operations), flag them now and we'll add to the MAP.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the milestones and attach the MAP. Thanks all — talk Friday if that sync holds.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
